## 1. Why one shared FIFO pool fails

A shared pool caps total connections, not each tenant’s share. Tenant 1 can occupy every pooled connection with 100 slow reports. Requests from the other 499 tenants then wait behind it or time out. FIFO admission also lets a Tenant 1 burst fill the queue before other tenants arrive.
